High item 4 (C-01-04) resolved: r21-trust-profiles.e2e.spec.ts compiles AppModule.forRoot() in all four profiles. In local-sandbox and test it proves that DetranClinicalTrustReadiness is not bound. In staging-like and production it resolves the binder, adapter and readiness from the real module (app.module.ts:716-726). It requires 'up' only with complete HTTPS config and a successful health check, and requires rejection plus readiness 'down' for http:// and for a missing token. There is no port or interface token: consumers inject PadesSigningHttpAdapter directly, so no alternative local provider can exist.
